protected_region: Entire published-foreground bounding box plus 15 pixels; any foreground at an image corner excludes the case
selection: Original model test split; DermArtifactDB ink=0 and ruler=0; exclude known published-mask ink positives; all six safe placements required
inference: Frozen original LoRA model, prompt and saved processor; threshold 0.5; no tuning
primary: Per-artifact mean target-minus-permutation-control logit margin (mel minus nv), averaged over three designs per image
control: Same bounding box; deterministic permutation of RGBA tuples, preserving exact color/opacity histogram and painted area
bootstrap: Whole-lesion cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws; marginal exploratory 95% intervals
limitation: Synthetic overlays and noise-like controls; masks may be imperfect; test set previously explored; no independent confirmation
